label: Suárez's profile against the unbundled composition step: controls

Two beings whose nature is other than being itself, each with its esse really identical with its essence, esse actualizing the nature, nothing received. At most one real-identity being fails, real otherness of non-own beings fails, the real-otherness form of the second unde holds vacuously, and its content form fails. It witnesses where Suárez's account escapes: at stage (b)'s uniqueness on OWN_BEING_2 (75b5b027), not at reception given real otherness.
